name: What kind of local businesses benefit most from AEO services?

mainEntity.name: What kind of local businesses benefit most from AEO services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local businesses that directly answer common customer questions about their products, services, or locations benefit most from AEO. This includes service-based businesses like plumbers, electricians, dentists, and lawyers, as well as retail stores, restaurants, and medical practices. Any business where customers frequently search for 'near me' information, operating hours, pricing, appointments, or specific product availability can leverage AEO to become the direct answer. Businesses with detailed, informative websites are often well-positioned for AEO optimization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Service-based businesses, retail, restaurants, and medical practices that answer common local customer questions about their offerings or location benefit most from AEO.
